notes.imagePolicy: in-game Recipe Book or isolatable potion bottle icons only; no shared table art, no scene screenshots, no text recipe posters assigned to named rows
notes.imageAcceptedMissingReason: No source publishes isolatable per-potion icons. Available media is (1) Fandom/UI Potion Table craft station art, (2) competitor full-scene screenshots with characters holding unlabeled flasks, (3) Fandom text-only recipe list poster. Assigning any of those to specific named potions would misidentify items. Collection ships text-first; refresh when Recipe Book icon tiles appear online.

item.name: Minor Healing Potion
item.ingredients: Healing Essence + Fish Filet + Any Metal
item.cardSummary: Light heal brew when you only have one Healing Essence and basic food plus metal.

item.name: Healing Potion
item.ingredients: Healing Essence + Any Goo + Stew
item.cardSummary: Mid heal that spends Goo and Stew for a stronger top-up mid fight.

item.name: Greater Healing Potion
item.ingredients: Healing Essence + Healing Essence + Chowder
item.cardSummary: Top single-target heal using two Healing Essences and Chowder for hard island fights.

item.name: Healing Ward
item.ingredients: Healing Essence + Any Goo + Healing Essence
item.cardSummary: Area heal from two Healing Essences and Goo when your crew needs shared recovery.

item.name: Deadeye Potion I
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Crab Sticks + Any Metal
item.cardSummary: Starter gun-damage brew for pistol and rifle users on island clears.

item.name: Deadeye Potion II
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Pistol Ammo + Any Metal
item.cardSummary: Stronger gun-damage tier that spends Pistol Ammo for big ranged output.

item.name: Brawler's Brew I
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Potato + Any Wood
item.cardSummary: Early melee damage boost when you fight with blades and close range tools.

item.name: Brawler's Brew II
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Shark Steak + Any Goo
item.cardSummary: High melee damage brew that burns Shark Steak and Goo for blade-focused runs.

item.name: Arcane Elixir I
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Stew + Any Metal
item.cardSummary: Entry magic-damage potion for spell-leaning loadouts.

item.name: Arcane Elixir II
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Seafood Slice + Any Goo
item.cardSummary: Higher magic-damage tier that uses Seafood Slice and Goo.

item.name: Vampire Tonic I
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Any Goo + Meat
item.cardSummary: Light lifesteal brew so hits refund a small share of health.

item.name: Vampire Tonic II
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Attack Essence + Meat
item.cardSummary: Stronger lifesteal that spends two Attack Essences and Meat.

item.name: Power Potion I
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Fish Sandwich + Big Gas Can
item.cardSummary: Flat all-damage boost when you do not want to pick only gun, melee, or magic.

item.name: Power Potion II
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Shark Steak + Gas Drum
item.cardSummary: Top all-damage brew for bosses and dense fights when you can spare Shark Steak and a Gas Drum.

item.name: Buddy Brew I
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Gas Drum + Fish Filet
item.cardSummary: First companion-power brew for runs that lean on a equipped pet buff.

item.name: Buddy Brew II
item.ingredients: Attack Essence + Attack Essence + Swordfish Steak
item.cardSummary: Max companion-power brew using two Attack Essences and Swordfish Steak.

item.name: Hearty Tonic I
item.ingredients: Defense Essence + Jar of Jelly + Any Metal
item.cardSummary: Raises max Health by a fifth so you can take more hits before healing.

item.name: Hearty Tonic II
item.ingredients: Defense Essence + Defense Essence + Lobster Tail
item.cardSummary: Larger max-Health pool from two Defense Essences and Lobster Tail.

item.name: Ironskin Potion I
item.ingredients: Defense Essence + Any Metal + Defense Essence
item.cardSummary: Cuts all damage taken by 15% with two Defense Essences and metal.

item.name: Ironskin Potion II
item.ingredients: Defense Essence + Defense Essence + Any Metal
item.cardSummary: Stronger damage reduction at 30% off all hits with the same essence-and-metal set in the listed order.

item.name: Invincibility Elixir I
item.ingredients: Defense Essence + Defense Essence + Shotgun Ammo
item.effect: Immune to all damage for 120 seconds
item.cardSummary: Full damage immunity for two minutes when you need a safe window through a dangerous push.

item.name: Invincibility Elixir II
item.ingredients: Defense Essence + Defense Essence + Defense Essence
item.effect: Immune to all damage for 180 seconds
item.cardSummary: Longer full immunity for three minutes at the cost of three Defense Essences.

item.name: Camouflage I
item.ingredients: Defense Essence + Any Goo + Calamari
item.effect: Angler Fish cannot detect you for 5 minutes
item.cardSummary: Hides you from Angler Fish detection for five minutes while you travel open water.

item.name: Fortune Brew
item.ingredients: Utility Essence + Utility Essence + Fish and Chips
item.cardSummary: Raises Doubloons from loot and rewards by 25% while the buff lasts.

item.name: Builder's Brew
item.ingredients: Utility Essence + Utility Essence + Gas Drum
item.cardSummary: Cuts material cost on buildables by a quarter for raft expansion sessions.

item.name: Swiftness Potion
item.ingredients: Utility Essence + Buttered Bass + Any Metal
item.cardSummary: Sprint speed boost for island scouting and quick retreats.

item.name: Hunger Brew
item.ingredients: Utility Essence + Stew + Chowder
item.cardSummary: Slows hunger drain by half so long trips burn less food.

item.name: Bouncy Potion
item.ingredients: Utility Essence + Cooked Bird + Any Metal
item.cardSummary: Adds two mid-air jumps for climbing cargo ships, cliffs, and awkward island geometry.

item.name: Big Gulp
item.ingredients: Wacky Essence + Rifle Ammo + Cooked Bird
item.cardSummary: Size-up transform for fun or visibility; stack carefully with other wacky effects.

item.name: Tiny Tincture
item.ingredients: Wacky Essence + Pistol Ammo + Potato
item.cardSummary: Shrinks your character for novelty runs and tight spaces.

item.name: Featherweight Flask
item.ingredients: Wacky Essence + Jar of Jelly + Any Goo
item.cardSummary: Lowers gravity so jumps and falls feel lighter while the brew lasts.

item.name: Fart Flask
item.ingredients: Wacky Essence + Stew + Potato
item.cardSummary: Novelty gag brew with no serious combat use.

item.name: Phantom Potion
item.ingredients: Any Goo + Any Goo + Any Goo
item.cardSummary: Ghost Pirate transform that only needs three Goo and no Wacky Essence.

item.name: Chum in a Bottle
item.ingredients: Wacky Essence + Sushi + Any Goo
item.cardSummary: Pulls an Angler Fish to your area—use only when you want that fight, not for escape.

item.name: Crab Cocktail
item.ingredients: Wacky Essence + Crab Sticks + Any Goo
item.cardSummary: Crab transform novelty brew with Crab Sticks and Goo.

item.name: Castaway Potion
item.ingredients: Wacky Essence + Wacky Essence + Any Goo
item.cardSummary: Random island teleport when you want a surprise jump or a fast getaway from a bad spot.

item.name: Raft Teleport
item.ingredients: Wacky Essence + Wacky Essence + Any Wood
item.cardSummary: Instant return home after long island runs or when you need a clean escape.
